slides.title: Send text reminders to phone bookings too: missed pickups could fall from 1 in 9 to 1 in 14
reasons: Reminders worked for online bookings: missed pickups fell from 19% to 7%
Phone bookings got no reminder and stayed at 19%
Phone is a third of bookings but more than half of missed pickups
slides.footnote: 1 in 14 assumes phone bookings respond to reminders as online bookings did. The pilot tests that.
slides.notes: Lead with the ask. The three lines underneath are the next three slides, in order. If they push back on 1 in 14, go straight to the footnote: it's an assumption and the pilot is how we check it.

slides.tag: Missed pickups · what changed in July
slides.title: Reminders cut missed online pickups from 19% to 7%; phone bookings, which get none, stayed at 19%
slides.notes: Point at the dashed line first: that's 1 July, reminders start. Then the green line drops and stays down. The grey line is the comparison that matters: same pantry, same months, no reminder, no change.

slides.notes: Read the two bars top to bottom. Phone is the dark part. Same people, a third of the bookings, more than half of the missed parcels. That's where the next gain is.
